title: Theme and chassis layout
target: Make a dimensioned layout that supports the circuit and drivetrain.
criteria: Use dimensions to check that parts fit.
Explain a structural choice with evidence.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: A cardboard decoration will pass close to a rotating wheel. Which layout check is most useful?
options: Show the wheel’s full moving outline and leave clearance from the decoration.
Place the decoration against the tire for support.
Check only the car’s color.
Ignore the wheel until race day.
cpa.guide: A moving-part envelope identifies interference even when the car looks clear at rest.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A top-view drawing omits the switch location. Which revision best supports building and use?
options: Hide it under a permanently fixed battery.
Replace it with a theme title.
Place it against the axle so it holds the axle still.
Label an accessible switch position and its wire route clear of gears.
cpa.guide: The plan must locate functional parts and preserve access and clearance.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Select a claim supported by the stated evidence and assumptions.

cpa.prompt: A 21 cm chassis needs a 7 cm battery region, a 6 cm motor region, and two 1.5 cm gaps along its length. How much length remains?
options: 5 cm
8 cm
2 cm
11 cm
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A planned gap is 4 mm. The required minimum moving clearance is 6 mm. Which decision follows the dimensions?
options: Accept it because 4 is close to 6.
Remove all clearance.
Revise the layout to add at least 2 mm of clearance.
Change millimeters to centimeters without converting.
cpa.guide: The plan is 2 mm short of the stated minimum; dimensions, not appearance, decide fit.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.

cpa.prompt: A test panel sags into the axle path. Which revision has a physical justification?
options: Disconnect the switch permanently.
Add a light support outside the moving path and retest clearance under load.
Add decoration directly onto the axle.
Ignore sag because the drawing is straight.
cpa.guide: A support can limit deflection while preserving movement; the loaded retest checks the claim.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Select a claim supported by the stated evidence and assumptions.

cpa.prompt: Two layouts fit the theme. Layout A leaves the battery unsecured; B includes a secure holder clear of gears. Which evidence favors B?
options: Theme appearance proves mechanical reliability.
A holder can prevent battery motion from pulling wires or contacting moving parts.
The holder creates extra electrical energy.
A loose battery always improves steering.
cpa.guide: Mechanical restraint protects wiring and clearance. It does not generate energy.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Select a claim supported by the stated evidence and assumptions.
